no_database: This hub has no database, so marketplaces aren’t available
token_unreadable: Can’t decrypt the marketplace token (did the hub’s secret.key change?). Enter it again
too_many: Too many marketplaces. Remove some first
address_taken: Another marketplace already uses this address
bad_signature_install: The marketplace’s signature is invalid, so nothing is installed or updated from it for now: {err}
token_and_token_from: Give either token or token_from, not both
pin_rotated_pending: The official signing key was updated. Installation stays blocked until the catalog verifies with the new key
settings_load_failed: Could not load marketplace mirror settings. Retry.
settings_save_failed: Could not save marketplace mirror settings. Retry.
settings_invalid: Invalid mirror URL. Use HTTPS without credentials, query, or fragment; the catalog needs its complete JSON URL.
